|---|---|

201:    slugify(title: string) {                          →  makeSlug(title: string) {
```

No other callers — no controller, test, or DTO references it. (The `slug` npm import on line 202 is a different thing and stays.)

One doc reference also goes stale:
```
.claude\knowledge\workspace.md:87:  `ArticleService.slugify()` = ...  →  `ArticleService.makeSlug()`
```

To unblock, either:
1. **Approve the node command** (preserves UTF-8 exactly, incl. the em dashes in `workspace.md`):
   ```
   node -e 'const fs=require("fs");for(const p of ["src/article/article.service.ts",".claude/knowledge/workspace.md"]){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");fs.writeFileSync(p,s.split("slugify").join("makeSlug"))}'
   ```
